physics_goals.quote: NA57 extended the physics scope of WA97 by extending centrality range and by also taking data at a lower beam energy (40𝐴 GeV/𝑐) in order to study the energy dependence of the hyperon enhancements.
physics_goals.value: Extend the WA97 measurements of hyperon enhancement to a wider centrality range and a lower beam energy (40A GeV/c)

summary.plain: NA57 continued WA97's study of strange particles in lead-lead collisions at CERN after the programme moved from the West Area to the North Area, extending the centrality range and adding a lower beam energy to study how hyperon enhancement depends on energy.
summary.technical: NA57: silicon-pixel telescope (about one million channels) in the Goliath magnet in the SPS North Area measuring strange and multi-strange baryon and K0s production in Pb-Pb at 158A and 40A GeV (data of 1998 and 2000 in the nucleus-nucleus modification-factor paper); successor of WA97.
